observability.$comment: Readable Sentry stack traces: set your Sentry organization and project slugs and app.config.ts adds the Sentry Expo plugin (source maps from builds), metro.config.js adds Debug IDs (getSentryExpoConfig) and the release lane uploads each update's source maps (release.sentry). Then add SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN to the EAS environments and the GitHub release environment. Empty, all of it stays off. README, Observability.

starter.$comment: The blocks each starter.config.ts switch carries. A block whose switch is off isn't in genesis.lock.json, and genesis upgrade and migrate leave it out (genesis init --without leaves its files out too).
